option_relations.rationale: Decompensated biventricular heart failure (HFrEF) is a specific type of acute decompensated heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and volume overload.
Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy with pre-excitation is a distinct cardiac condition not directly related to the provided leaf.

Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) pattern with heart failure exacerbation describes a specific ECG finding combined with heart failure, but the leaf is a general diagnosis of decompensated heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
Decompensated heart failure is a broader category that includes acute decompensated heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and volume overload.
